portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Your best work, shown on your public page. Client galleries always stay private.
portfolio.publishOnHint: Anyone with the link can see these images.
portfolio.publishOffHint: Only you can see this portfolio.
portfolio.publishFailed: The portfolio couldn't be updated. Try again.
portfolio.noSlugBody: Pick a public address such as photnoo.com/p/your-studio in Settings. Then you can publish.
portfolio.allowanceNote: Portfolio images don't use your storage allowance.
portfolio.dropBody: JPEG or PNG, up to 15 MB each. They upload one at a time.
portfolio.full: Your portfolio is full ({max} images). Remove some to add more.
portfolio.queueDone: {count, plural, one {# image added} other {# images added}}
portfolio.queueFailedCount: {count, plural, one {# image failed} other {# images failed}}
portfolio.emptyBody: Add 15 to 40 of your strongest images. Mix categories so visitors can filter by the work they need.
portfolio.reorderHint: Drag images to reorder them, or use the move handle with the keyboard.
portfolio.moveInstructions: Press Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel.
portfolio.reorderFailed: The new order couldn't be saved. It was put back.
portfolio.deleteBody: It will be removed from your portfolio and your public page. This can't be undone.
portfolio.deleteFailed: The image couldn't be deleted. Try again.
portfolio.caption: Caption
portfolio.captionHint: Shown in the lightbox on your public page.
portfolio.saveFailed: The details couldn't be saved. Try again.
